# teams agent user delete

Delete an Agent 365 agentic user and its agent identity, keeping the blueprint

## Usage

```
teams agent user delete [userIdOrUpn] [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description | Required |
|----------|-------------|----------|
| `userIdOrUpn` | [OPTIONAL] Agentic user’s object ID or UPN to delete. Overrides agent.generated.config.json when given; required if no local config exists. | No |

## Options

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--json` | [OPTIONAL] Output as JSON |
| `--dry-run` | [OPTIONAL] Show what would be deleted without making any changes |
